purpose: use full-image context for explicit cross-view vehicle class conflicts; correlated crop counts are diagnostic only
development_role: post-failure viewed-data design informed by the preserved75TP/31FP majority result; not fresh heldout evidence
base: exact unchanged full-plus-three-crops detector and v1 conflict components/eligible per-view proposals
policy: on each complete component choose class of the eligible full-image vote regardless of crop vote counts; without full-image vote preserve all hypotheses and mark ambiguity
selection: retain original highest-ranked global box of that class; original confidence, geometry, source view/rank and output order unchanged
unchanged: car/bus/truck group2/5/7; conflictIoU>.45; score>=.3; original local/global classwise NMS; no threshold or per-image tuning
bounds: same4 views/1200 proposals/300 outputs/1200000 comparison work/4MiB JSON bounds

evaluation.data: all8 viewed BDD frames and138 unchanged original references
evaluation.relative_adoption: retain every original78 reference match and per-class count, false positives<33; otherwise no recommendation
evaluation.independent: NumPy reconstruction of entire original merge/votes plus separate full-context projection; preserve all native raw outputs; all8 native CPU images twice
evaluation.confidence: fixed5-bin descriptive Brier/ECE; no fitted/calibrated confidence or independent crop probability claim

defaults: keep all existing binaries including failed vote mode unchanged; explicit new binary only
